(in-package :game-2048)

(defun slide-row (row)
  (let* ((tiles (remove 0 row))
         (result nil)
         (score 0))
    (loop while tiles do
      (if (and (cdr tiles) (= (car tiles) (cadr tiles)))
          (let ((merged (* 2 (car tiles))))
            (push merged result)
            (incf score merged)
            (setf tiles (cddr tiles)))
          (progn (push (car tiles) result)
                 (setf tiles (cdr tiles)))))
    (values (append (nreverse result)
                    (make-list (- 4 (length result)) :initial-element 0))
            score)))

(defun %copy-board (board)
  (let ((copy (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0)))
    (dotimes (r 4 copy)
      (dotimes (c 4) (setf (aref copy r c) (aref board r c))))))

(defun move (board direction)
  (unless (member direction '(:left :right :up :down))
    (error "Invalid direction: ~S" direction))
  (let ((result (%copy-board board)) (score 0))
    (dotimes (i 4)
      (let* ((rowp (member direction '(:left :right)))
             (line (loop for j below 4 collect
                         (if rowp (aref board i j) (aref board j i))))
             (oriented (if (member direction '(:right :down))
                           (reverse line) line)))
        (multiple-value-bind (slid gained) (slide-row oriented)
          (incf score gained)
          (when (member direction '(:right :down)) (setf slid (reverse slid)))
          (dotimes (j 4)
            (if rowp (setf (aref result i j) (nth j slid))
                (setf (aref result j i) (nth j slid)))))))
    (values result score
            (not (loop for r below 4 always
                       (loop for c below 4 always
                         (= (aref board r c) (aref result r c))))))))

(defun spawn-tile (board random-state)
  (let ((empty nil))
    (dotimes (r 4)
      (dotimes (c 4)
        (when (zerop (aref board r c)) (push (cons r c) empty))))
    (unless empty (error "Cannot spawn on a full board"))
    (let* ((copy (%copy-board board))
           (cell (nth (random (length empty) random-state) empty))
           (value (if (zerop (random 10 random-state)) 4 2)))
      (setf (aref copy (car cell) (cdr cell)) value)
      copy)))

(defun won-p (board)
  (loop for r below 4 thereis
    (loop for c below 4 thereis (= (aref board r c) 2048))))

(defun game-over-p (board)
  (loop for direction in '(:left :right :up :down)
        always (not (nth-value 2 (move board direction)))))

(defun %print-board (board score output)
  (format output "Score: ~D~%" score)
  (dotimes (r 4)
    (dotimes (c 4) (format output "~5D" (aref board r c)))
    (terpri output)))

(defun play (&key (input *standard-input*) (output *standard-output*)
                  (random-state (make-random-state t)))
  (let ((board (make-array '(4 4) :initial-element 0)) (score 0)
        (announced-win nil))
    (setf board (spawn-tile board random-state)
          board (spawn-tile board random-state))
    (%print-board board score output)
    (loop
      (when (game-over-p board)
        (format output "Game over.~%")
        (return))
      (let ((line (read-line input nil nil)))
        (when (or (null line) (string-equal line "q")) (return))
        (let ((direction (cdr (assoc (string-downcase line)
                                     '(("w" . :up) ("a" . :left)
                                       ("s" . :down) ("d" . :right))
                                     :test #'string=))))
          (when direction
            (multiple-value-bind (next gained changed) (move board direction)
              (when changed
                (setf board (spawn-tile next random-state))
                (incf score gained)
                (when (and (not announced-win) (won-p board))
                  (format output "You won!~%")
                  (setf announced-win t))
                (%print-board board score output)))))))))
